title: Inductive step for two-function hypercontractivity
statement:
Let $p, q \ge 1$ and let $\rho$ satisfy $0 \le \rho \le 1$, and write $T_\rho$ for the noise operator with parameter $\rho$. Suppose the two-function bound
\[
  \langle f, T_\rho g\rangle \;\le\; \bigl(\E[\abs{f}^p]\bigr)^{1/p}\,\bigl(\E[\abs{g}^q]\bigr)^{1/q}
\]
holds for every pair of functions $f, g$ on the one-dimensional cube $\{0,1\}^1$, and also for every pair of functions on the $n$-dimensional cube $\{0,1\}^n$. Then the same bound holds for every pair of functions $f, g : \{0,1\}^{n+1} \to \bbr$.
hypotheses_covered: base case: bound holds for all pairs on the 1-bit cube
inductive hypothesis: bound holds for all pairs on the n-bit cube
replaced:
Let $p, q \ge 1$ and $0 \le \rho \le 1$. If the bound
$\inn{f, T_\rho g} \le (\E[\abs{f}^p])^{1/p}(\E[\abs{g}^q])^{1/q}$ holds for all pairs of
functions on one bit and for all pairs of functions on $n$ bits, then it holds for all
$f, g : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,(n+1) \to \bbr$.
